## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 8, 2026 - Sep 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Anthony Smith_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "I haven't used the app in some time. As a matter of fact I uninstalled the app due to me finding another app. Unfortunately the app didn't give me the option to cancel my subscription and I'm still getting charged for something I don't have so, my ratings are changing and my subscription needs to be canceled immediately"
            2. _Erin Love_, Sep 15, 2026, 1/5: "I have canceled my subscription through Google Play. Store, as the app requires you to do. And I'm still being charged month after month. Getting to customer service, there's no easy way. How some of the reviews on here are so high, It's unbelievable. There's no easy way to cancel your account. The only way I can see is to cancel the account through google play service and then turn around and block each and every charge."
            3. _Arlene Mingils_, Sep 14, 2026, 1/5: "Not clear on pricing! Beware ⚠️. I never received an answer on how much I was being charged!! I was just told that they would cancel my subscription 😡"
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Review examples:**
